demo.title: fetch-aero-daily.sh
demo.code:
# Fetch today's Base Aero snapshot (top 50 pools, free, no API key)
curl -s https://docs.zap.capital/data/aero/latest.json | jq '{date: .snapshot.date_utc, block: .snapshot.block_number, totals: .totals}'

# Top 5 pools by Allocation Power
curl -s https://docs.zap.capital/data/aero/latest.json | jq '.pools[:5] | map({rank, pool_name, allocation_pct, fee_pct, volume_24h_usd, gross_swap_fees_24h_usd_est, tvl_usd})'

# Flat CSV for quick tabular inspection
curl -s https://docs.zap.capital/data/aero/latest.csv | head -n 6

setup: No API key, signup, or payment required
Fetch https://docs.zap.capital/data/aero/latest.json (or latest.csv) once per day after ~06:30 UTC
